## README

# Aider Installation Guide

Get started quickly with aider, an AI-powered coding assistant.

## Quick Installation with aider-install

If you have Python 3.8-3.13 installed:

```bash
python -m pip install aider-install
aider-install
```

After installation, change to your project directory and run aider with your preferred model:

```bash
# Work with DeepSeek via DeepSeek's API
aider --model deepseek --api-key deepseek=your-key-goes-here

# Work with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic's API
aider --model sonnet --api-key anthropic=your-key-goes-here

# Work with GPT-4o via OpenAI's API
aider --model gpt-4o --api-key openai=your-key-goes-here

# Work with Sonnet via OpenRouter's API
aider --model openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet --api-key openrouter=your-key-goes-here

# Work with DeepSeek via OpenRouter's API
aider --model openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-chat --api-key openrouter=your-key-goes-here
```

## One-Line Installation

### Windows
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://aider.chat/install.ps1 | iex"
```

### Mac & Linux
Using curl:
```bash
curl -LsSf https://aider.chat/install.sh | sh
```

Using wget:
```bash
wget -qO- https://aider.chat/install.sh | sh
```

## Alternative Installation Methods

### Install with uv
```bash
python -m pip install uv  # If you need to install uv
uv tool install --force --python python3.12 aider-chat@latest
```

### Install with pipx
```bash
python -m pip install pipx  # If you need to install pipx
pipx install aider-chat
```

### Install with pip
Consider using a virtual environment when installing with pip. Compatible with Python 3.9-3.12.

```bash
python -m pip install -U --upgrade-strategy only-if-needed aider-chat

# To work with GPT-4o:
aider --4o --openai-api-key sk-xxx...

# To work with Claude 3.5 Sonnet:
aider --sonnet --anthropic-api-key sk-xxx...
```

Note: If you encounter "aider command not found" errors, try using `python -m aider`.

## Using Aider with LM Studio

1. First, download and install LM Studio from their website
2. Open LM Studio and download your preferred model (e.g., deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8b)
3. Load the model in LM Studio
4. Click the "Play" button to start the local server

Then set up the environment variables (on Windows):
```powershell
# Set these environment variables (only needed once)
setx LM_STUDIO_API_KEY "sk-no-key-required"
setx LM_STUDIO_API_BASE "http://localhost:1234/v1"
```

After setting the environment variables, open a new PowerShell window and run:
```powershell
# Replace <model-name> with your actual model name
aider --model lm_studio/<model-name>

# For example, with deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8b:
aider --model lm_studio/deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8b
```

### Using Aider

Once aider starts, you can:
1. Navigate to your project directory using `cd /path/to/your/project`
2. Start coding! Type your questions or requests, and aider will help you write and edit code
3. Use `/help` to see available commands
4. Use `/exit` to quit aider

Note: Make sure LM Studio's server is running (play button pressed) before starting aider.

## Package Managers
While aider is available in various system package managers, it's recommended to use one of the methods above as package managers might install incorrect dependencies.

## Next Steps
After installation, check out the optional installation steps and usage instructions to start coding with aider.
